text_block_list.text:
One day on the training track, I spotted 
Narita Brian speaking to some horse girls 
who appeared to be junior students.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Hey. Listen.

text_block_list.name: Junior Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: Eep?! I-I'm so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Junior Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
W-We're in your way, right?! We're sorry! 
We'll move somewhere else right away!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What's the matter? What happened here?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Nothing, I was just calling out to them 
about that matter...

text_block_list.name: Junior Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text: Um... What do you mean by "that matter"?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah. Actually, there is an upcoming academy 
event, and we're planning to hold a 
special race as part of it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
We were just looking for test runners for 
the track in order to prepare for it.

text_block_list.name: Junior Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so that's what it was. I'm sorry for 
jumping to conclusions without 
listening...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it. So, would you be 
willing to lend us a hand?

And so, the test run got underway, 
however...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAAAAHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Junior Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry! There's no way I can do this~!

text_block_list.name: Junior Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Running side-by-side with you is way too 
terrifying, Senpai...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Brian! Stop shouting with that 
menacing roar and making that terrifying 
face. We can't even conduct a test run 
like this.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Putting my voice aside, there's nothing I 
can do about my face...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... While that may be true, at this 
rate we can hardly call this a test run.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Isn't there some way we can dispel that 
misleadingly intimidating image of 
yours...?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, I just had a great idea. You two, let 
me tell you a story from the past.

text_block_list.name: Junior Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text: A story from the past...?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The truth is, Brian used to be a total 
crybaby.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Wha—?! What are you blurting out?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I don't know about now, but she couldn't 
fall asleep at night without her stuffed 
animal. Now what was that plushie's name 
again...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Shut up!! What are you saying?! Have you 
lost your mind?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Well, what I'm trying to say is, I want 
you to realize that Brian isn't any 
different from an ordinary horse girl.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Just like you, there are things she fears, 
and as you can see, she gets embarrassed 
too. So, there's really no need to be 
scared.

text_block_list.name: Junior Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
You're right... It's true that we were 
just being scared entirely on our own...

text_block_list.name: Junior Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text: ...We're sorry. We'll do our best and run!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...I don't really care. More importantly, 
let's run already!

And so, the course check was completed 
without further incident, however...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Good grief. It's been a long time since I 
felt that humiliated...! You've got some 
nerve doing that!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
My apologies. But if I hadn't done that, 
they would have been too scared to run in 
the first place, wouldn't they?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The optimal move to foster familiarity is 
laughter. Besides, wouldn't you say the 
fact our juniors are no longer afraid of 
you is quite a harvest?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You sure know how to spin things... 
Seriously.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... But don't forget. I know plenty of 
embarrassing stories about you too, Sis.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Like what happened the first time you went 
to an amusement park, for instance...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey, hold on, Brian...?! Bringing that 
up is foul play...!!
